subject: gk
question: What percentage of the water that falls on land returns to the atmosphere through evaporation from over the oceans as well as from other places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**59%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total Earth's surface covered by water is 75%__.
 
• About 75% of the Earth’s surface is water-covered and the oceans hold about 96.5% of all Earth’s water.
 __
 
• Water also exists in the air as water vapor in rivers and lakes, icecaps and glaciers, and in the ground as soil moisture.
 
• **Nearly 59 percent of the wate**r that falls on land returns to the atmosphere through evaporation from over the oceans as well as from other places.
 
• The remainder runs off on the surface and infiltrates into the ground or a part of it becomes a glacier.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Total water on earth is primarily divided into two parts:
 
 
• Freshwater (2.5%)
 
• Saline water (97.4%) (oceans and seas)
 
 
 
• Freshwater is again divided into four parts:
 
 
• Icecaps and glaciers (68.7%)
 
• Groundwater (30.1%)
 
• Surface water (0.3%) (lakes, ponds, rivers, streams, etc.)
 
• Others (0.9%) (soil moisture, atmospheric moisture, etc.)
